title: Emergency Powers
description: Quiz on constitutional emergency declarations, safeguards, and limitations.

questions.question: Emergency powers aim to:
questions.explanation: They enable rapid response while preserving core norms.

questions.question: True or False: Some rights remain non-derogable during emergencies.
questions.explanation: Certain fundamental rights stay protected always.

questions.question: Select safeguards on emergency powers.
questions.explanation: Temporal, legislative, and judicial checks prevent abuse.

questions.question: Risk of indefinite emergency rule:
questions.explanation: Extended emergencies can erode democratic norms.

questions.question: Select all components that deepen understanding of Emergency Powers.
options: Irrelevant myths unrelated to the topic
questions.explanation: Core concepts, applicable frameworks, and practical examples build robust understanding; unrelated myths do not.

questions.question: Case studies help apply abstract concepts to real situations.
questions.explanation: Applying concepts in realistic contexts strengthens comprehension and recall.

questions.question: Which study approach most improves retention of key ideas?
questions.explanation: Active recall and practice yield better retention than passive reading or cramming.

questions.question: What is a practical way to connect Emergency Powers to real-world decisions?
options: Relate concepts to local news or policies
questions.explanation: Linking concepts to current events and local policies improves understanding and relevance.

questions.question: Select good strategies to evaluate claims about this topic.
options: Rely solely on anonymous social posts
Look for credible data and context
questions.explanation: Verifying against primary sources, mandates, and credible data yields more reliable conclusions.

questions.question: Who declares a state of emergency and on whose recommendation?
options: President on Council of Ministers recommendation
questions.explanation: The President declares on recommendation of the Council of Ministers.

questions.question: Select rights that cannot be suspended even during emergencies.
questions.explanation: Core rights like life, habeas corpus, and protection against torture are preserved.

questions.question: True or False: Parliament must approve an emergency within 30 days.
questions.explanation: Parliamentary approval is required within 30 days.
